whats_new_body:
Version 2.0.0:
• App Lock with PIN and Biometric.
• Anonymous Boxes with encrypted chat.
• Encrypted database (SQLCipher).
• Share intent from other apps.
• Settings screen.
• Auto-delete messages.
• Character counter.
• General improvements.
how_to_use:
• Set a PIN in Settings to lock the app.
• Use Encrypt/Decrypt for quick text encryption.
• Create Boxes for organized conversations.
• Share encrypted text from WhatsApp/Telegram.
• Messages in boxes stay encrypted until decrypted.
disclaimer_body: This app is provided 'as is' without warranties. The developer is not responsible for any data loss or security breaches. Always keep backups of your encrypted data and passwords in a safe place.
